When to send your Save the Dates for your 2026/27 wedding?⁠  
⁠  
The earlier you plan, the easier it is for everyone to show up (especially for destination or peak-season weddings). Here’s our guide..⁠  
👉🏼 October 2026 wedding → send by December 2025⁠  
👉🏼 November 2026 wedding → send by January 2026⁠  
👉🏼 December 2026 wedding → send by February 2026⁠  
⁠  
Then, moving into 2027…⁠  
⁠  
👉🏼 January 2027 wedding → send by March 2026⁠  
👉🏼 February 2027 wedding → send by April 2026⁠ [...] 👉🏼 March 2027 wedding → send by May 2026⁠  
👉🏼 April 2027 wedding → send by June 2026⁠  
👉🏼 May 2027 wedding → send by July 2026⁠  
👉🏼 June 2027 wedding → send by August 2026⁠  
👉🏼 July 2027 wedding → send by September 2026⁠  
👉🏼 August 2027 wedding → send by October 2026⁠  
👉🏼 September 2027 wedding → send by November 2026⁠  
👉🏼 October 2027 wedding → send by December 2026⁠  
👉🏼 November 2027 wedding → send by January 2027⁠  
👉🏼 December 2027 wedding → send by February 2027⁠  
⁠ [...] ⁠  
Extra time never hurts if it’s a destination or peak-season date, think 10–12 months out. The sooner guests know, the smoother the planning feels for everyone (and yes, we have timelines for every stage).⁠  
⁠
